scholarshipNotice.body: Please find attached the <0>result PDF</0> of the Vidyashri Scholarship Exam for your information. Based on the first round, the top 25 rank holders have been shortlisted for the second round comprising an interview and document verification. We may invite more students for the second round, if required.
scholarshipNotice.reporting: The shortlisted students of Class 11 are requested to report at <1>10:00 AM</1> and those of Class 9 at <2>01:00 PM</2> on <3>31st March 2025</3> at Amatir Kanya Gurukul.

notes.point2: Kindly bring Government-approved Income Proof Documents, if available, for verification.
notes.point3: Clearing the written exam does not guarantee admission. Admission is subject to qualification in the second round.
notes.point4: The final list of students qualifying for Vidyashri 100% scholarship will be communicated only to concerned parents.

scholarshipNotice.closing: We look forward to welcoming you.

whyPoints.point2: Amatir Kanya Gurukul – where tradition meets modern education

InDetail.scholarhipMeans: Empowering talented girls from economically disadvantaged families with modern education, traditional values, and India’s best competitive exam preparation at absolutely zero cost. <1>Exclusively for Class 11 (Science Stream) | Only 24 Merit-Based Seats Available!</1>
InDetail.whatScholarDesc: Initiated and funded by the <1>Anant Charitable Trust</1>, this scholarship aims to remove the financial barriers stopping brilliant girls from achieving their dreams. In partnership with <1>Amatir Kanya Gurukul</1> and <1>PW Vidyapeeth (Physics Wallah)</1>, we provide a safe, culturally rooted environment combined with expert academic guidance to ensure your daughter's bright, self-reliant future.
InDetail.eligibilityTitle: <1>What is Included? (100% Free) This is a 100% financial assistance initiative. The scholarship completely covers:

Points.point1: <1>Full School Tuition Fees:</1> Education specifically for Grade 11 (Science Stream).
Points.point2: <1>Hostel & Transport:</1> 24x7 secure boarding and day-boarding facilities for girls.
Points.point4: <1>Competitive Coaching:</1> Free on-campus <1>IIT-JEE, NEET, NDA and CUET</1> preparation.

InDetail.pwDesc:
<1>Best Preparation in a Safe Gurukul Through our exclusive "School Integrated Program", the trusted experts from
<1>PW Vidyapeeth (Physics Wallah) will teach directly inside our secure campus.

pwPoints.point1: <1>Comprehensive Preparation:</1> Board exam focus seamlessly integrated with a competitive edge.
pwPoints.point2: <1>Expert Guidance:</1> Benchmark performance nationally with top-tier educators.
pwPoints.point3: <1>Proven Results:</1> Backed by PW Vidyapeeth’s legacy of producing top ranks, including <1>JEE Advanced 2025 AIR 3, 12 and 48</1> and <1>NEET (UG) 2025 AIR 87 and 100.</1>
